# FinTrack

> Open-source personal finance management web app — expense tracking, a lent & debt
> ledger, an investment portfolio tracker, and AI-powered insights, in a self-hostable,
> mobile-first PWA. Users own their data 100%: it lives in their own Supabase project,
> with full export and full delete.

FinTrack combines expense tracking (with budgets, a no-spend streak, CSV import/export),
a lent & debt ledger for tracking money owed between people, an investment portfolio
tracker (ROI, P&L, installments, returns), and optional AI features (categorization,
anomaly detection, digests, budgeting help) powered by a user-supplied free Groq API key.
